report: hunter round 5 report (2026-10-23), arm J5-sampled: four exposure questions and a render-or-readiness question over the cut risk moment and the diff less tests, docs and lockfiles, sampled per file to 75,000 characters, combined by mean; cut-off 0.2228 chosen to minimise the cost-weighted loss (a miss priced at 5 hunter reads) on 77 labelled runs and unchanged on 97; fresh holdout (20 runs, frozen on 77) accuracy 0.70 against 0.65 for always running, loss $0.020 per decision below always running, AUC 0.824; on Jev by the operator's ruling of 2026-10-23

note.text: the change's diff: tests, docs and lockfiles left out

calls_outside.instructions: Look only at the production code this change adds or edits. Does it call an outside process, command, service, API, file, or database and then act on what comes back?

criteria.true: The changed code calls something outside the program and uses its result or exit status.
criteria.false: The changed code calls nothing outside the program, or only text, configuration, or pure logic changed.

new_outside_code.instructions: Does this change build new code that talks to outside programs, services, files, or a database, rather than adjusting text, configuration, tests, or a small piece of existing logic?

criteria.true: The change adds new code paths that depend on outside programs, services, files, or a database.
criteria.false: The change adjusts text, configuration, tests, renames, or a small piece of existing logic.

outside_dependence.instructions: How much of the production code this change adds or edits calls outside programs, commands, services, APIs, files, or a database and acts on the result?
criteria: None: only text, configuration, tests, renames, or pure logic changed.
One or two small outside calls added or touched in existing code.
A few outside calls, with their handling.
Several new code paths built on outside calls.
A large new piece of software built mainly on outside calls.

many_failure_points.instructions: Does this change add several new places where a call to an outside program, service, file, or database could fail, each needing its own handling?

criteria.true: Several new places in the changed code can fail because of something outside the program.
criteria.false: The changed code adds no new place, or only one, where an outside failure can occur.

render_or_readiness.instructions: Look only at the production code this change adds or edits. Does it add or change a screen, component, native module, or device or platform call whose result depends on something being ready in time: data still loading, a layout, permission, or subscription not yet set up, a native call or event that may fail or never arrive, or async state (effects, listeners, timers, stores) that decides what the user sees?

criteria.true: The changed code renders UI or calls a native module or device API, and what it shows or does depends on data, a call, an event, or a state that may be missing, late, or failed.
criteria.false: The changed code renders no UI and calls no native module or device API, or what it renders is fixed: text, styling, layout constants, renames, or tests only.
